headlines.title: Altria Group (MO) Stock Still Appears Undervalued Following Its 153% Run
headlines.summary: Altria Group has delivered strong share price gains in recent years, which puts fresh attention on what investors are paying for its cash flows today. With the stock now around US$76.75, the key issue is whether the current market tag lines up with the cash the business can generate over time. Over the past 5 years, Altria Group has returned about 152.6%, which puts a lot of past optimism and reinvested confidence on the line when you ask what its cash flows are worth now.

headlines.title: Altria (MO) stock is up, what you need to know
headlines.summary: Shares of tobacco company Altria (NYSE:MO) jumped 3.5% in the afternoon session after The company reported third-quarter adjusted earnings per share and revenue above expectations, raised its full-year adjusted earnings per share guidance, and expanded its share repurchase program. According to a company press release, Altria reported third-quarter adjusted diluted earnings per share of $1.52, up 4.8% and above the analyst estimate of $1.51. Revenues net of excise taxes rose 3.6% to $5.

headlines.title: Altria’s Unusual Call Activity Offers a Lower-Risk Way to Wait for a Payoff
headlines.summary: Altria owns 42.5% of Cronos Group and 8.1% of AB InBev, providing a lower-risk backdoor play. A 5.9% dividend yield pays you to wait, but longer-dated calls might be better than the unusually active Nov. 20 calls.

description: Altria Group, Inc., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells smokeable and oral tobacco products in the United States. It offers cigarettes primarily under the Marlboro brand; large cigars and pipe tobacco under the Black & Mild brand; moist smokeless tobacco and oral tobacco products under the Copenhagen, Skoal, Red Seal, and Husky brands; oral nicotine pouches under the on! brand; and e-vapor products under the NJOY ACE brand. The company sells its products to distributors, as well as large retail organizations, such as chain stores. Altria Group, Inc. was founded in 1822 and is headquartered in Richmond, Virginia.
